result.title: SHP099 is a potent allosteric SHP2 inhibitor
result.abstractText: SHP099 selectively inhibits SHP2 and suppresses RAS-MAPK signalling in sensitive models.

result.title: SHP2 inhibition fails to sustain pathway suppression in colorectal models
result.abstractText: SHP099 did not inhibit pERK in DLD1 xenografts and no significant tumour growth inhibition was observed.
